name: koa-micro
title: Koa microservice (TypeScript-only)
description: A Koa 2 + TypeScript microservice. Ships Redis (ioredis + BullMQ) built-in, structured logger (pino), zod env, /livez + /readyz health endpoints, multistage Dockerfile, and k8s manifests. Database (pg | mysql | none) is a scaffold-time feature axis.
